verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents concrete background automations — 'AI Close' agents that autonomously reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies during month-end, plus custom categorization rules and batch auto-categorization (up to 98%) that run without manual triggering. However these are fixed, accounting-specific automations rather than a general-purpose 'set up your own automation' framework, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of unattended runs. Missing for 10: user-configurable triggers/schedules for arbitrary automations, evidence of true autonomy without review gates, and independent verification of background execution.
